# 2.2.3 No Timing (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.2 Enough Time
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/no-timing.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#no-timing

## Normative text

Timing is not an [essential](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-essential) part of the event or activity presented by the content, except for non-interactive [synchronized media](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-synchronized-media) and [real-time events](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-real-time-events).

## Sufficient techniques

- G5: Allowing users to complete an activity without any time limit
